name: chinese-cribbage-app
description: Native Android/iOS shell for Chinese Cribbage, wrapping the existing single-file web engine with Capacitor.

scripts.sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:online && npm run test:newfeatures && npm run test:resume && npm run test:isolation
